articles.summary: Brinker International, Inc. (NYSE: EAT) has scheduled its earnings conference call at 11 a.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, to review first quarter fiscal 2027 earnings, which will be announced before the market opens on October 28, 2026. The company may also provide other business updates. The live audio webcast can be accessed through Brinker's investor relations website . A replay of the conference call will be available on the website for one year after the event. ABOUT BRINKER Brinker International, Inc. ( NYSE: EAT ) is one of the world's leading casual dining restaurant companies and proud home to two beloved brands: Chili's® Grill Bar and Maggiano's Little Italy® . Brinker has grown to own, operate or franchise more than 1,600 restaurants across 29 countries and two U.S. territories – serving bold flavors, handcrafted drinks, and genuine hospitality along the way. articles.summary: Launching nationwide Oct. 20, the new chicken sandwich features Chili's iconic Fried Mozz The Highlights Chili's is introducing the new Chicken Parm Big Crispy chicken sandwich, which starts with a base of Chili's Big Crispy chicken sandwich, then adds its viral Fried Mozzarella and marinara sauce for a big, crispy, cheesy take on Chicken Parm and a whole new way to get that perfect cheese pull. Since Chili's Big Crispy lineup was introduced in April, the grill bar's chicken sandwich orders have grown 175%.* Chicken Parm isn't from Italy — and neither are Florence, Ky.; Rome, Ga.; or Venice, Fla. — making them a fitting first stop for the new sandwich. Guests in all three cities can be the first to try the Chicken Parm Big Crispy starting Oct. 13, before it's available nationwide on Oct. 20.
